AR_IF_BATTERY_STATE.content: Vehicle-facing battery state frame, sent on a 100 ms cycle. Data elements: soc_permille, capacity_mAh, stateValid.
AR_IF_BATTERY_STATE.title: BatteryState_I

AR_IF_CELL_MEASUREMENTS.content: Validated cell voltages and cell temperatures, one sample per 10 ms cycle. Data elements: cellVoltages_mV, cellTemperatures_dC, measurementValid.
AR_IF_CELL_MEASUREMENTS.title: CellMeasurements_I

AR_IF_CHARGE_INTEGRAL.content: Charge integral of the pack current in ampere-seconds. Data elements: charge_As.
AR_IF_CHARGE_INTEGRAL.title: ChargeIntegral_I

AR_IF_CONTACTOR_COMMAND.content: Open command from the safety supervisor to the contactor drivers. Data elements: openCommand.
AR_IF_CONTACTOR_COMMAND.title: ContactorCommand_I

AR_IF_ESTIMATE_VALIDITY.content: Trustworthiness verdict for the state-of-charge estimate. Data elements: estimateReliable.
AR_IF_ESTIMATE_VALIDITY.title: EstimateValidity_I

AR_IF_ISOLATION_STATUS.content: Isolation resistance per volt of pack voltage and the derived isolation fault. Data elements: isolation_OhmPerVolt, isolationFault.
AR_IF_ISOLATION_STATUS.title: IsolationStatus_I

AR_IF_OVERCURRENT_CONDITION.content: Debounced overcurrent condition after the 100 ms persistence window. Data elements: overcurrentActive.
AR_IF_OVERCURRENT_CONDITION.title: OvercurrentCondition_I

AR_IF_PACK_CURRENT.content: Signed pack current, discharge positive, sampled at 1 ms. Data elements: packCurrent_mA, currentValid.
AR_IF_PACK_CURRENT.title: PackCurrent_I

AR_IF_PACK_VOLTAGE.content: Pack voltage as the sum of the validated cell voltages. Data elements: packVoltage_mV.
AR_IF_PACK_VOLTAGE.title: PackVoltage_I

AR_IF_POWER_LIMIT.content: Permitted discharge power after thermal derating. Data elements: permittedDischargePower_W.
AR_IF_POWER_LIMIT.title: PowerLimit_I

AR_IF_PROTECTION_FAULT.content: Latched cell-protection fault with the cell, the limit and the measured value. Data elements: faultActive, cellId, limitId, measuredValue.
AR_IF_PROTECTION_FAULT.title: ProtectionFault_I

AR_IF_REMAINING_CAPACITY.content: Remaining capacity of the pack; never increases over the life of the pack. Data elements: capacity_mAh.
AR_IF_REMAINING_CAPACITY.title: RemainingCapacity_I

AR_IF_STATE_OF_CHARGE.content: Fused state-of-charge estimate in per mille of rated capacity. Data elements: soc_permille.
AR_IF_STATE_OF_CHARGE.title: StateOfCharge_I

AR_IF_THERMAL_REQUEST.content: Cooling and heating request to the coolant pump and the pack heater. Data elements: coolingRequest, heatingRequest, requestId.
AR_IF_THERMAL_REQUEST.title: ThermalRequest_I

AR_IF_THERMAL_STATE.content: Highest and lowest valid cell temperature and their spread. Data elements: highestCellTemp_dC, lowestCellTemp_dC, spread_dK.
AR_IF_THERMAL_STATE.title: ThermalState_I

AR_SWC_CELL_MEASUREMENT_ACQ.content: Reads all cell voltages and temperatures from the analogue front-end every 10 ms.
AR_SWC_CELL_MEASUREMENT_ACQ.title: Cell Measurement Acq

AR_SWC_CONTACTOR_ACTUATOR.content: Drives the two contactor coils as a dual-channel low-side pair.
AR_SWC_CONTACTOR_ACTUATOR.title: Contactor Actuator

AR_SWC_COOLANT_ACTUATOR_IF.content: Forwards the thermal request to the coolant pump and the pack heater and supervises the acknowledgement.
AR_SWC_COOLANT_ACTUATOR_IF.title: Coolant Actuator If

AR_SWC_COULOMB_COUNTER.content: Integrates the signed pack current on a 10 ms tick.
AR_SWC_COULOMB_COUNTER.title: Coulomb Counter

AR_SWC_CURRENT_PATH_MONITOR.content: Samples the shunt amplifier at 1 ms and debounces the overcurrent condition over 100 ms.
AR_SWC_CURRENT_PATH_MONITOR.title: Current Path Monitor

AR_SWC_ESTIMATION_VALIDITY_MONITOR.content: Flags the estimate unreliable when the pack current is stale for 5 seconds.
AR_SWC_ESTIMATION_VALIDITY_MONITOR.title: Estimation Validity Monitor

AR_SWC_FAULT_MEMORY.content: Stores cell-protection fault records in a non-volatile ring of 64 entries.
AR_SWC_FAULT_MEMORY.title: Fault Memory

AR_SWC_ISOLATION_MONITOR.content: Reduces the insulation measurement and the pack voltage to ohm per volt and derives the isolation fault.
AR_SWC_ISOLATION_MONITOR.title: Isolation Monitor

AR_SWC_OCV_CORRECTOR.content: Anchors the state of charge on the open-circuit voltage after 30 minutes of rest.
AR_SWC_OCV_CORRECTOR.title: Ocv Corrector

AR_SWC_POWER_LIMIT_CALCULATOR.content: Derates the permitted discharge power linearly between 55 and 60 degrees Celsius.
AR_SWC_POWER_LIMIT_CALCULATOR.title: Power Limit Calculator

AR_SWC_SAFETY_SUPERVISOR.content: Single decision point of cell protection: evaluates limits, latches the fault, commands the contactors open.
AR_SWC_SAFETY_SUPERVISOR.title: Safety Supervisor

AR_SWC_SOC_STORE.content: Keeps the non-volatile shadow of the published state of charge.
AR_SWC_SOC_STORE.title: Soc Store

AR_SWC_SOH_TRACKER.content: Derives the remaining capacity from the charge counted between two rest anchors.
AR_SWC_SOH_TRACKER.title: Soh Tracker

AR_SWC_STATE_PUBLISHER.content: Sends the battery state frame to the vehicle every 100 ms.
AR_SWC_STATE_PUBLISHER.title: State Publisher

AR_SWC_THERMAL_STATE_EVALUATOR.content: Reduces the cell temperatures to highest, lowest and spread and derives the thermal requests.
AR_SWC_THERMAL_STATE_EVALUATOR.title: Thermal State Evaluator
